en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?

I'm scared I'll sprain my fingers,
so I'll pass.

It's not like I can go to a hospital here
either...

I feel like you should say that *after* you
take me out to a date...

Oh, it's pretty important to stretch
before a performance.

If you don't stretch before an intense
performance, you can injure your fingers.

When we do our duet later,
I'll show you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
